question: In which year did Maharaja Ranjit Singh established his capital at Lahore?
solution: The correct answer is __**1799**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Maharaja Ranjit Singh** established his capital at **Lahore in 1799**. This marked the beginning of his reign as a significant ruler in North India. • In **1799**, Ranjit Singh captured Lahore after defeating the Bhangi Misl, one of the Sikh confederacies, and made it his political and administrative center. • Lahore was strategically important due to its location on the trade routes and its historical significance as a cultural and administrative hub. • Under his rule, Lahore became the capital of the **Sikh Empire**, which extended across Punjab, Jammu, and Kashmir, and parts of modern-day Pakistan. • This establishment of Lahore as the capital strengthened Ranjit Singh's empire and consolidated his power in the region.
